root_commands.help: Show help information, optionally with -a for all commands
root_commands.ai-review: Run a two-phase AI code review and export the result
root_commands.oo-source: Calculate CK/LK metrics from multi-language source files
root_commands.oo-diagram: Calculate diagram-level OO metrics from XML/OOM class diagrams
root_commands.fp: Calculate function points from a JSON file
root_commands.project-scan: Scan a project directory for code volume, dependencies, diagrams, and god files
root_commands.project-report: Scan a project and export a full report (including PDF)
root_commands.cfg-source: Generate control flow metrics from source files
root_commands.cfg-graph: Calculate complexity from a structured control flow graph

arguments.topic: Optional command path, for example serve or test backend

options.-a, --all: Show all command summaries and page them in an interactive terminal

ai-review.summary: Run a two-phase AI code review
ai-review.usage: python backend\cli.py ai-review <path> [-M MODEL] [-F json|markdown|html|pdf] [-o PATH] [--phase1-file review1.json] [--phase2-file review2.json]

options.-m, --modules: Optional modules: inventory, loc, dependency, oo, design
options.-d, --ignore-dir: Append an ignored directory name; repeatable
options.-g, --ignore-glob: Append an ignored glob pattern; repeatable
options.-G, --no-ignore-file: Disable reading the project-root ignore file
options.-D, --no-default-ignore: Disable the built-in ignored directory set
options.--phase1-file: Offline test fixture for phase-1 AI JSON
options.--phase2-file: Offline test fixture for phase-2 AI JSON

oo-source.summary: Calculate CK/LK and structural metrics from multi-language source files

arguments.files: One or more source file paths

test.backend.usage: python backend\cli.py test backend [-s unit|smoke|all] [-S] [-u URL] [-H HOST] [-p PORT]

options.-u, --base-url: Base URL when backend is already running
